changelogs: - Requires msk_core 4.1.0 or newer, update both together
- Notifications use the table form of msk_core 4.1.0, so the deprecation warnings are gone. If you keep your own config, copy the new Config.Notification lines
- The msk_core version is checked on start and an error is logged in the server console when it is too old
- Replace fxmanifest.lua, config.lua and server/versionchecker.lua to update
- Changed files [fxmanifest.lua, config.lua, server/versionchecker.lua]
- Requires msk_core 4.0.0 or newer, update both together
- Runs on QBCore and Qbox now. es_extended is no longer a dependency, the resource used to refuse to start without it

- Added Config.Commands.ausreise.startMoney. The balance clear_money sets is configured here now instead of being read from ESX.GetConfig().StartingAccountMoney. Add the block to your config.lua, without it clear_money does nothing
- The character table is resolved instead of hardcoded: users/identifier on ESX, players/citizenid on QBCore and Qbox
- /einreise and /ausreise run through MSK.RegisterCommand, same behaviour but on every framework
- The login and logout handlers listen to msk_core:playerLoaded and msk_core:playerLogout, bound server-local so no client can fire them with a foreign player id
- The appearance after admin mode is restored through whichever resource runs: illenium-appearance, qb-clothing or esx_skin with skinchanger
- Fixed that /rein crashed when admin_outside is set to last_position, it called the ESX method getCoords that no longer exists
- Fixed that /raus teleported into nowhere when no position had been stored
- Fixed that both admin commands ran into a nil player when typed in the server console
- Fixed that the logout and drop handlers indexed a player that was already gone, which let the admin counter drift upward over a session
- Fixed that the isNew column was added to the wrong table on QBCore and Qbox, where every player counted as not new
- Replace the whole resource to update, and add startMoney to your config.lua
- Changed files [fxmanifest.lua, config.lua, client/main.lua, server/main.lua, server/functions.lua]
- Fixed Error: `attempt to call a nil value (method 'match')`
- Fixed Error with Commands
- Completely reworked the code
- Updated Callbacks for msk_core
- Performance Improvements
- Some Bugfixes
- Performance Improvements
- Added Timeout for the Bell
- Added new Ban Methods
- Bugfixes
- Improved performance
- Added new AdminProtections
- Added Changelogs to the VersionChecker
- New method for Nametags (much better performance)
- Release
